input._script:
using MPI
using CUDA
using JSON3

MPI.Init()
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
nranks = MPI.Comm_size(comm)

input = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
a_host = Float32.(input.a)
b_host = Float32.(input.b)
n = length(a_host)

local_result = Dict{String,Any}()

# --- raw CUDA.jl on this rank's local GPU ---
try
    CUDA.device!(0)
    function vadd_kernel!(y, a, b)
        i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
        if i <= length(y)
            @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
        end
        return nothing
    end
    a_dev = CuArray(a_host)
    b_dev = CuArray(b_host)
    y_dev = CUDA.zeros(Float32, n)
    threads = 256
    blocks = cld(n, threads)
    @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks vadd_kernel!(y_dev, a_dev, b_dev)
    CUDA.synchronize()
    local_result["cuda"] = Dict("result" => Array(y_dev), "device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
catch e
    local_result["cuda"] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
end

# --- CUDA-aware MPI test: device buffer straight across nodes, no host
# copy. Same check as the gpua30 multi_node health check. ---
mpi_result = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    if nranks < 2
        mpi_result["error"] = "expected 2 MPI ranks, got $nranks"
    else
        CUDA.device!(0)
        buf = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank), 4)
        if rank == 0
            MPI.Send(buf, comm; dest=1, tag=0)
            mpi_result["sent"] = true
        elseif rank == 1
            MPI.Recv!(buf, comm; source=0, tag=0)
            mpi_result["received"] = Array(buf)
        end
    end
catch e
    mpi_result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end

hostname = gethostname()
this_rank_payload = Dict("hostname" => hostname, "local" => local_result, "mpi" => mpi_result)

# Only rank 0 prints. rank 1 sends its payload to rank 0 over MPI so the
# one printed line carries both ranks' results.
if rank == 0
    final = Dict{String,Any}("rank0" => this_rank_payload)
    if nranks >= 2
        try
            final["rank1"] = MPI.recv(comm; source=1, tag=1)
        catch e
            final["rank1"] = Dict("error" => "failed to receive rank 1's payload: $(sprint(showerror, e))")
        end
    end
    println(JSON3.write(final))
elseif rank == 1
    MPI.send(this_rank_payload, comm; dest=0, tag=1)
end
